RitualOutcomeEffectDef.description: If the coffee roasting doesn't go terribly bad, the moralist will brew some coffee for the colony without needing harvested coffee beans. Better outcomes will produce more coffee. A spectacular coffee roasting might produce some specialty coffee if VE Brewing - Coffees and Teas is installed.
